thread:
mina: Quick brain-dump from today's sync: onboarding pipeline needs a "failure-mode" taxonomy and a lightweight fingerprint for golden sets. We're losing signal when teams only get a pass/fail.

rod: Agree. What if each probe returns a short failure_tags list (e.g., tokenization, kv_eviction, quant_drift, perf_regression) + a 64-char fingerprint of the golden comparison? That makes diffs searchable.

jas: Love that. fingerprint should be stable (hash of normalized tokens + truncation). We can store it in model metadata and index by fingerprint for regression hunting.

mina: Also propose a cost-aware promotion: each model registration has a bench_budget_usd and a promotion_budget window. If a model exceeds budgets, it's flagged and needs manual approval. Prevent infinite golden runs.

rod: Operational bits: add a "fuzz_depth" parameter to prober so we can run short fuzz passes for edgecases (max_mutations, max_seq). For PRs default fuzz_depth=10, full-golden fuzz_depth=1000.

ci-bot: note: schema preview added - fields: failure_tags, golden_fingerprint, bench_budget_usd, fuzz_depth.

jas: Minimal adapter handshake sketch:
```
adapter_handshake:
  lane: "smoke" | "staged" | "golden"
  fuzz_depth: 10
  simulate_prefix: "short"
  golden_fingerprint: ""
  allow_quantized: true
```

mina: For triage ergonomics: don't dump full artifacts on smoke failure. Instead include top 3 mismatches, fingerprint, and an artifact link for staged/golden. That reduces noise.

rod: For detecting flaky stateful issues we should add a "replay_variants" mode where the prober replays the same session with tiny timing perturbations (simulate real arrival jitter) and checks stability. If variance > threshold tag as "stateful_flaky".

jas: Nice. Add deterministic seeds so developers can reproduce: include seed in failure blob. CLI example:
```
rwi prober run --model rwi-9000 --lane staged --samples 120 --fuzz_depth 25 --seed 42
```

mina: Regarding golden ownership: bench team curates canonical golden sets, but model owners can propose additions. Add "golden_origin" metadata: bench|owner|external.

rod: Alerts & dashboards: surface top-failure_tags count over time, and a fingerprint histogram (new fingerprints should create an alert if rate spikes). That helps detect regressions from a new commit.

bench-bot: scheduled: staged rwi-9000 (120 samples, fuzz_depth=25) on bench-fleet  ETA 18m; artifact:/bench/arts/1791122348. :robot_face:

jas: One more: make prober harness versioned. If prober changes (e.g., tokenization fix) we can tie fingerprints to harness_version. That avoids false positives. Add harness_version to handshake.

mina: Good call. I'll draft an RFC that covers: taxonomy, fingerprint format, budgeted promotions, fuzz-depth, replay_variants, harness_versioning, CLI, and dashboards. I'll tag bench/orch/infra.

rod: Small implementation note: fingerprints should be computed in bench service after normalization to avoid SDK differences.

mina: If no objections I'll open the RFC tonight. :sparkles:
